findings.summary: _strict_grammar_accepts re-implements the strict accept predicate that imas_codex/standard_names/grammar_adapter.py:117 parse_canonical_name already owns (parse strict, compose, compare, raise on mismatch), and graph_foundation.py:691 already imports from that module, so the new definition forks an owned capability instead of extending it.

_seed wipes the whole shared disposable graph with MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n although the test does not request disposable_neo4j_empty, so when the full -m graph tier runs in one worker it destroys session-scoped data other modules planted and their failures land as order-dependent flakes.

The graph-tier row quotes '9 passed, 1 warning in 74.69s' from an unpersisted in-session run while the log it links, gate-logs/graph-head-seeds.log, reports 109.36s, and the correction to that row is an uncommitted working-tree edit so the merged fragment keeps the mismatched figure.
